name: selectorshub-mcp

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Open a URL in the SelectorsHub browser (keeps cookies/logins between sessions). Call this before other tools.

tools.name: list_elements
tools.description: List interactive elements on the current page (including inside open shadow DOM and iframes) with refs and their best Playwright and Selenium locators.

filter.description: Only elements whose text/attributes contain this, e.g. "login" or "button"

include_text.description: Also include non-interactive text elements such as headings and cells

tools.name: generate_locators
tools.description: Generate all SelectorsHub locators for one element: relative/indexed/absolute XPath, CSS, id/name/class/linkText, Playwright locators, testRigor path, shadow DOM host chain and iframe chain, each with its match count, plus a recommended pick and optional ready-to-paste code. Identify the element by ref, an existing locator, or its visible text/label.

ref.description: Element ref from list_elements or an earlier result, e.g. "e12"

locator.description: Any existing locator: XPath, CSS, Playwright (JS/Python/Java/C#), Selenium By.*, Cypress cy.get()

text.description: Visible text, label, placeholder, aria-label or title of the element

nth.description: 1-based index when the locator matches several elements

frameworks.description: Frameworks to generate ready-to-paste code for, e.g. ['playwright-ts'] or ['selenium-java']

preferred_attribute.description: Custom attribute to prefer, e.g. "data-qa" or "data-test-id"

exclude.description: Attributes the locators must not rely on (e.g. ['id'] when ids are generated)

relative_to.description: A stable anchor element; adds a SelectorsHub axes XPath locating the target relative to it

ref.description: Element ref from list_elements or an earlier result, e.g. "e12"

locator.description: Any existing locator: XPath, CSS, Playwright (JS/Python/Java/C#), Selenium By.*, Cypress cy.get()

text.description: Visible text, label, placeholder, aria-label or title of the element

nth.description: 1-based index when the locator matches several elements

tools.name: validate_locator
tools.description: Check a locator against the current page: syntax errors (with auto-correction), match count across frames and shadow DOM, uniqueness, fragility warnings, and a unique alternative when it matches several elements. Accepts XPath, CSS, Playwright (JS/Python/Java/C#), Selenium By.*, Cypress and WebdriverIO forms.

tools.name: fix_locator
tools.description: Repair a broken locator: corrects syntax errors, disambiguates locators that match several elements, and when a locator matches nothing (e.g. after a UI change) finds the element it was targeting and returns a new reliable locator.

hint.description: What the element is, e.g. "the login submit button"; improves matching after UI changes

frameworks.description: Frameworks to generate ready-to-paste code for, e.g. ['playwright-ts'] or ['selenium-java']

tools.name: generate_page_object
tools.description: Generate a page object class for the current page (or chosen elements) with the best locator for every element, in the requested framework and language. Handles iframes and shadow DOM.

class_name.description: Class name (default derived from the page title)

refs.description: Only these element refs (default: all visible interactive elements)

filter.description: Only elements whose text/attributes contain this

tools.name: page_action
tools.description: Interact with the page to reach the state you need locators for (log in, open a menu, go to the next step). Identify the element by ref, locator or text.

ref.description: Element ref from list_elements or an earlier result, e.g. "e12"

locator.description: Any existing locator: XPath, CSS, Playwright (JS/Python/Java/C#), Selenium By.*, Cypress cy.get()

text.description: Visible text, label, placeholder, aria-label or title of the element

nth.description: 1-based index when the locator matches several elements

value.description: Text for fill/type, key for press (e.g. Enter), option for select, milliseconds for wait

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the page, or one element highlighted in SelectorsHub orange (to confirm a locator points at the right thing).

ref.description: Element ref from list_elements or an earlier result, e.g. "e12"

locator.description: Any existing locator: XPath, CSS, Playwright (JS/Python/Java/C#), Selenium By.*, Cypress cy.get()

text.description: Visible text, label, placeholder, aria-label or title of the element

nth.description: 1-based index when the locator matches several elements

tools.name: close_browser
tools.description: Close the SelectorsHub browser. It reopens automatically on the next open_page.

instructions:
SelectorsHub gives you verified, reliable element locators (XPath, CSS, Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, WebdriverIO) generated by the SelectorsHub engine against the real page, including shadow DOM, iframes and SVG.

Use it instead of guessing locators whenever you write or repair UI automation:
1. open_page to load the app (the browser keeps logins between sessions; use page_action to click through to the state you need).
2. list_elements to see interactive elements with refs and their best locators.
3. generate_locators for the full set for one element (by ref, locator or visible text), with ready-to-paste code for the user's framework.
4. validate_locator to check any locator's match count; fix_locator to repair broken or ambiguous ones; generate_page_object for a whole page.
Always prefer the "recommended" locators, and pass the user's framework in "frameworks" so the code matches their stack.
